name: Mediterranean Salmon Parcels with Lemon-Dill Roasted Asparagus & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
3 small bunches asparagus
1 small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Place six 12-inch x 12-inch squares of parchment, side by side, on a flat surface with a corner pointing up (in a diamond shape). If counter space is limited, you can overlap parchment corners by 3-4 inches, leaving a space in the center for each fish fillet.
Pat the fish dry with paper towels, then place one fillet, skin-side down, horizontally in the middle of each diamond. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb salmon fillet
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic, then sprinkle over each fillet.
Peel and thinly slice shallots; lay slices over each fillet.
Halve the olives lengthwise. Thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes. Sprinkle both over each fillet.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
12 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice half the lemons and layer over each fillet (reserve remaining lemons for later).

Loosely pull the top and bottom corners of each piece of parchment towards the center, then roll and fold towards the center to seal. Loosely tuck the opposite sides of the parchment underneath each fillet; transfer fish parcels to a large baking sheet pan.
Place fish on the upper rack of the oven and bake until opaque and easily flakes with a fork, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus, then transfer to another, large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Juice remaining lemons over the asparagus.
Using a knife, shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Sprinkle half of the dill over the asparagus and toss to coat (set remaining dill aside for garnish).
Place the asparagus on the lower rack of the oven and bake until fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide fish parcels and asparagus between plates. Open the parcels and garnish with reserved dill; top asparagus with feta and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
